description:
廢土伺服器是目前台港澳最大的生存伺服器，共有超過20萬玩家加入，尖峰時段線上人數超過1500人、每個月有10,000名玩家保持活躍的伺服器。 #minecraft

享受Minecraft，工廠、農場、紅石、水流，盡量發揮你的創意。

採「程式自動化管理」，除了服主之外「無任何管理員」。任何問題都可以友善提問。

台港澳最大的麥塊伺服器 | 2025台灣地區伺服器推薦排名蟬聯第一

2025巴哈姆特官方統計伺服器推薦、線上人數排行榜雙雙連霸第一名

mcfallout.net is the largest Minecraft survival server in the Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau region. With over 180,000 registered players and more than 1,500 concurrent users during peak hours, it stands as one of the most active and vibrant Chinese-speaking Minecraft communities. Each month, over 10,000 players remain active, making it a cornerstone of survival gameplay in the Mandarin-speaking world.

🛠 Automation & Stability – A Worry-Free Minecraft Experience

Fully automated server protection: No commands required — your builds and land are automatically protected.

Intuitive Chinese GUI: Easy to use, even for beginners.

Automatic permission management: Reduces griefing and theft risks, keeping your creations safe.

🚀 Enterprise-Grade Hardware – Built for Performance

200-core CPU, 1.6TB RAM, 50TB SSD storage.

Real-time data backups, low-latency gameplay.

Optimized for redstone machines, farms, and automation systems with minimal lag.

🌍 Innovative World Generation – Classic Exploration, Reimagined

Brand-new world generation algorithm with enhanced biomes and terrain diversity.

Recaptures the nostalgic feel of classic Minecraft exploration — now with more depth.

Auto-respawning resources allow continuous survival without frequent map resets.

🛡️ Fair & Cheater-Free – Balanced Survival Gameplay

Anti-xray and anti-cheat mining systems built-in.

All resources must be gathered manually — no pay-to-win.

Balanced economy and sustainable in-game ecosystems support both survival and industry players.

🤝 Inclusive Community – Friendly for All Ages

Freedom, respect, and gender inclusivity are core community values.

Players can visit and learn from each other’s builds — a culture of collaboration.
